Question 1
?

Find the fourth-degree Taylor polynomial of ln⁡(x+1) about x=0.

a
x−x2+23x3−34x4
b
x−x2+23x3−14x4
c
x−12x2+13x3−14x4
d
x−12x2+13x3−34x4
e
x−12x2+14x3−13x4
